04defac9909866d7.description: About the Company Kodland is a fast-growing international digital school on a mission to help kids and teens unlock their creativity through coding, design, and digital skills. Thousands of students worldwide have already built their first websites, games, and digital projects with our support — and now we’re looking for passionate tutors to join us. About the Role Are you a programmer who loves coding and gaming? At Kodland, you’ll have the opportunity to turn your passion into impact by inspiring the next generation of creators. You’ll teach kids and teens how to design their own Roblox games, guiding them step by step as they bring their ideas to life. No prior experience with Roblox Studio? No problem — we’ll provide full training to help you succeed. This is a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere, as long as you’re available during UK teaching hours (afternoons/evenings on weekdays and mornings on weekends).
